question.worked_solution:
The sum of cubes formula is given by

$$
{a}^{3}+{b}^{3}=(a+b)({a}^{2}-ab+{b}^{2}).
$$

Notice that all of the terms have a common factor of $3.$ To simplify the computation, we can factor out the $3,$ as follows:

$$
81{n}^{3}+24=3(27{n}^{3}+8)
$$

The expression in parentheses can be written as a sum of cubes:

$$
3(27{n}^{3}+8)=3((3n)^{3}+{2}^{3})
$$

Now, we factor the expression in parentheses using the sum of cubes formula:

$$
\begin{aligned}81{n}^{3}+24 & =3((3n)^{3}+{2}^{3}) \\  & =3(3n+2)((3n)^{2}-3n\cdot 2+{2}^{2}) \\  & =3(3n+2)(9{n}^{2}-6n+4)\end{aligned}
$$
